jobs.title: Quality Assurance
jobs.location: 55 Trinity Avenue, Suite G700                            Atlanta,  Georgia    30303-0000
jobs.description:
Quality Assurance Architect & Manager 
General Description 
The Quality Assurance (QA) Architect & Manager oversees the full QA lifecycle for Atlanta Information Management’s (AIM) enterprise applications, ensuring that all software and infrastructure projects meet organizational requirements, function reliably, and provide a high-quality user experience. This role leads testing strategy, QA team performance, and the development of scalable quality frameworks. Responsibilities include defining testing standards, architecting automation strategies, and ensuring alignment with organizational and end-user expectations across all of AIM’s initiatives. 
Essential Duties & Responsibilities 
Quality Leadership & Strategy 
·         Provide management of the full QA lifecycle, ensuring consistent quality across proprietary and enterprise systems. 
·         Lead and oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles to ensure solutions meet business expectations and improve employee processes. 
·         Documentation services including Test Plans, Regression Testing, and Smoke Testing. 
·         Facilitate all testing phases and ensure results are documented and tracked accurately. 
·         Certify the functionality, reliability, accessibility, and performance of production applications. 
·         Automate regression tests using repeatable, scalable scripts. 
·         Ensure all projects meet client team expectations and align with requirements. 
·         Perform verification activities on web-based proprietary software to ensure ongoing product quality. 
·         Assign, schedule, and oversee daily activities of QA team members. 
·         Delegate appropriately based on skill sets and responsibilities. 
·         Promote and foster an environment that proactively supports change, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
·         Review and analyze team workload before making assignments and project decisions. 
·         Infuse a learning culture and drive continual improvement within the QA team. 
·         Hold staff accountable with clear direction and measurable objectives. 
·         Engage employees in ongoing performance conversations. 
·         Empower team members to meet project objectives and customer expectations. 
·         Coordinate with AIM Management and HR on personnel matters such as development, performance, and discipline. 
·         Develop training programs for all QA positions to support skill growth and cross-training. 
Cross-Department Collaboration & Governance 
·         Manage enterprise application projects and priorities in collaboration with other division managers. 
·         Review and develop cross-divisional project schedules. 
·         Develop and maintain processes, procedures, and policies as appropriate. 
·         Recommend strategic technology or business system changes to the CIO and leadership teams. 
·         Contribute to short- and long-term strategic planning for the IT Department. 
·         Manage and administer service level agreements (SLAs) with business clients. 
·         Share responsibility for major IT governance processes such as Change Management, Release Management, and Request Management. 
·         Establish and enforce technical standards related to database, server, desktop, development, and other environments. 
·         Ensure customer service experience and communication with stakeholders remain a top priority. 
·         Recommend and manage assigned budgets, including capital project budgets. 
·         Monitor performance to ensure city funds are managed responsibly and transparently. 
·         Oversee and strengthen relationships between the Enterprise Applications Team and business stakeholders. 
·         Lead the selection, design, integration, and operation of enterprise applications and business software solutions across the city. 
Additional Leadership & Architecture Responsibilities 
·         Define QA architectural standards and frameworks, including test data management, test environment management, and automation architecture. 
·         Evaluate and implement modern QA tools, technologies, and platforms to increase efficiency and automation maturity. 
·         Establish KPIs, dashboards, and quality metrics to monitor product quality, team performance, and release readiness.  
·         Conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) for defects and production issues, ensuring long-term corrective actions. 
·         Ensure compliance with security, accessibility/ADA, data governance, and regulatory requirements. 
 
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities 
This is a partial list of the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities for the role: 
·         Ability to consistently meet deadlines and manage competing priorities. 
·         Experience working on software development teams and within modern SDLC frameworks. 
·         Excellent soft skills, including communication, collaboration, and conflict resolution. 
·         Familiarity with ERP processes and enterprise application ecosystems. 
·         Programming skills sufficient for creating automated tests in various languages. 
·         Knowledge of Agile Testing principles and the full SDLC framework. 
·         Cross-browser and cross-platform testing experience. 
·         Experience with tools such as SOAP-UI, TestIM, Selenium, Appium, Cypress, BrowserStack, Percy, and related platforms. 
·         Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how automated testing integrates with DevOps workflows. 
·         Ability to mentor QA engineers and interns, develop technical career paths, and conduct skills assessments. 
·         Strong analytical and architectural thinking skills, especially in evaluating risk, complexity, and scalability 
 
 
 
Minimum Qualifications – Education & Experience 
·         Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience in Information Technology, Business, Public Administration, or related field. 
·         5 years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise applications, including at least 2 years in Project Management or equivalent leadership roles. 
·         Proficiency with MS Office, MS Project, MS Visio, and MS SharePoint.

jobs.title: IN-DOH-Oral Health Educator
jobs.description:
The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. Oral Health Educator Job Description: Overview:\u2028The Oral Health Educator will play a pivotal role in promoting oral health awareness and education across skilled nursing facilities, schools, early learning centers, and community settings. This position will focus on equipping Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), school nurses, educators, children and families, and community partners with the knowledge and skills needed to support oral hygiene practices, preventive care, and improved oral health outcomes. Responsibilities: ● Training & Education: Develop and deliver tailored workshops, and training sessions for CNAs, school nurses, early learning centers, and community partners on oral health best practices. ● Resource Development: Create and distribute educational materials such as guides, checklists, pamphlets, posters, videos, and digital content tailored to skilled nursing facilities, school settings, and families. ● Collaboration: Work closely with Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) leadership, school administrators, healthcare professionals, and community organizations to align oral health education with patient care protocols, school health needs, and community-based initiatives. ● Oral Health Advocacy: Promote the importance of oral health in overall health, especially for elderly residents, chronically ill patients, children, and vulnerable populations. ● Support & Guidance: Serve as a resource to CNAs, school nurses, educators, and community partners by providing ongoing support, answering questions, and offering solutions to oral health challenges. ● Outreach & Events: Support planning, coordination, and participation in community outreach events, health fairs, school-based programs, and public health campaigns to expand oral health awareness and access. ● Program Support: Assist with program planning, preparation and distribution of oral health education materials, grant proposals, budgets, data collection, and reporting. ● Evaluation: Monitor and assess the impact of educational programs and outreach activities and recommend improvements to enhance care delivery, school-based prevention, and community engagement. Qualifications: ● Bachelor’s degree or certification in Dental Hygiene, Public Health, Education, or a related field. ● Experience delivering health education or training programs, preferably in school, healthcare, long-term care, or community settings. ● Knowledge of oral hygiene practices, common dental conditions, preventive care strategies, and behavior change techniques. ● Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage CNAs, school nurses, healthcare teams, educators, families, and community partners. ● Ability to develop accessible, engaging, and culturally appropriate educational materials. ● Familiarity with skilled nursing facility workflows, school health programs, and public health outreach preferred. ● Relevant background in public health, data management, program evaluation, and grant writing preferred.
